name: pulser audio
changelog:
• Professional Seamless Background Auto-Updates: Linux and Windows desktop updates download silently in the background (matching apps like Brave, VS Code, Discord)
• Zero-Password Linux AppImage Updates: Portable Linux AppImage updates seamlessly with zero pkexec root password prompts
• Silent Per-User Windows Updates: Windows NSIS installer runs per-user with 1-click relaunch
• Offline Shuffle Isolation: Shuffling offline playlists or All Tracks stays strictly within local offline tracks
